description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials for selected friends"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_CreateBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetPriorities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_UpdateList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseActions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FarmingBot</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FarmResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplySetback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_SetbackApplied</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Boundary_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyMilestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MilestoneNotified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateBot" name="Begin creating a farming bot">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfigureDependencies" name="Configure tool and resource dependencies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Dependencies_FarmResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Dependencies_FarmResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Farm_ChooseActions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">min(selectedResourceCount, 10)</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes during farming" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster_ApplySetback</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Disaster">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">naturalDisasterOccurs</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply farming setback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster_ApplySetback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Setback_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SetbackApplied" name="Farming setback applied">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Setback_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_Milestone" name="Farming milestone reached" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingMilestoneReached</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestone_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified" name="Milestone notification sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_UpdateList" name="Player requests farming list update" attachedToRef="Task_FarmResources" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateList_UpdateTask</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_UpdateList">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farmingListUpdateRequested</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateList_UpdateTask</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateTask_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateTask_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseActions" name="Choose post-farming actions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farm_ChooseActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Choose_PostActions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" name="Select post-farming actions" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Choose_PostActions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_SendMaterials</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_NoAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_SendMaterials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Materials_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" name="Complete selected actions" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Materials_PostActionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_NoAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostActions_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FarmingBot" name="Farming bot process complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostActions_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectResources" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateBot" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_SetPriorities" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_FarmResources" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_ChooseActions" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="Task_ChooseActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_ApplySetback" sourceRef="Boundary_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Setback_End" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_SetbackApplied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_Notify" sourceRef="Boundary_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_MilestoneNotified"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateList_UpdateTask" sourceRef="Boundary_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateTask_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_PostActions" sourceRef="Task_ChooseActions" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">bragSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sendMaterialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_NoAction" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not bragSelected and not sendMaterialsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_PostActionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_PostActionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostActions_End" sourceRef="Gateway_PostActionsJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_FarmingBot"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot Process" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
